parsing_traps: STAPLED TRUST: financials report HBT Group / H-REIT Group / Stapled Group in 3 columns — Stapled Group column is canonical (used throughout).

Statement of Total Return places Depreciation (S$25,299k) BELOW NPI (cost-model PPE hotels), so it is included in operating_expense, not property opex. NPI line (129,694) reconciles to revenue (267,566) minus property expenses (137,872).

Portfolio Statement splits properties into Investment Properties (14, Σ 2,479,867k) and Property, Plant & Equipment (9 hotels + 'Other plant and equipment', PPE Σ 873,081k). market_valuation taken from the audited Stapled Group Portfolio Statement '000 (p213-215). Per-property GR/NPI from 'Performance by Country and Property' (p28-29): 'Properties with Leases' use Gross Rental Revenue; 'Managed Properties' use Gross Hotel Revenue. Both feed gross_revenue; totals reconcile to 267,566 / 129,694.
